name: fix-firearms-reload-world
about: The reload bar sits over the player in the world, not on the bottom HUD (2026-10-22, the user's item 2): Combat.as OverReloadState.Render anchors it RELOAD_BAR_ABOVE (34) px above the player's interpolated position, the Over-Reload gold window unchanged. Through the fix_firearms_feel bot: an emptied clip starts the automatic reload, the bar logs where it drew, a frame of it, and `hwp firearms reload` says 'over player: drawn at x,y' centred on the player 34 px up.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:firearms\] reload bar: over the player at -?\d+,-?\d+ \(gui\), 34 px up
